component.name: Corewatch
component.summary: Watch your processor, memory, processes and more

description.p: Corewatch is a native system monitor for Linux. It shows what your computer is doing right now, with a live graph for every resource.

ul.li: Overview: every resource on one page
Processes: sort by CPU or memory, search, and end a stuck program
Processor: total usage, one graph per core, model and frequency
Memory: used, available, cache, buffers and swap
Graphics: usage or clock, video memory and temperature
Disks: activity, read and write speed, and free space
Network: download and upload speed, addresses and Wi-Fi signal
Battery: charge, time remaining, power draw and health

description.p: It follows the system light and dark style and accent color, and adapts to narrow windows.

screenshot.caption: Download and upload speed per interface

ul.li: New Overview page with every resource at a glance
New Processes page with app icons and per-process download and upload speeds: sort, search, and end or force-stop a process
New Network page: speeds, addresses, link speed and Wi-Fi signal
Temperatures and fan speeds on the page they belong to, and a Sensors page for the rest
Preferences: start page or last page, graph history, temperature unit, binary or decimal sizes, and bits or bytes for network speeds
New Graphics, Disks and Battery pages
Preferences: color scheme and update speed
A banner tells you when a data source stops answering
Installable with Meson, and available as a Flatpak

description.p: Log file and clearer error reports.
